description: This file defines the Vtiger_Webservice class which provides API methods for initializing and uninitializing web service support in vtiger CRM modules. It includes utility logging and interacts with external functions to manage module web service support.

classes.name: Vtiger_Webservice
classes.description: Provides static methods to support webservice initialization and deinitialization for vtiger CRM modules.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message using Vtiger_Utils, optionally appending a linebreak.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up webservice support for a given module instance if it is an entity type.

methods.name: uninitialize
methods.description: Removes webservice support for a given module instance if it is an entity type.
